call_goal: Learn whether Glasswing Analytics has a real problem watching its agents, why now, and who else cares
desired_outcomes: Their top problems in their words

transcript.text: How are the agents instrumented today?
Bits and pieces. We have OTel everywhere for the services, but the LLM calls are just logged as text.
So, straight question: do you support OpenTelemetry? We've standardised on it and I'm not adding another agent to every box.

knowledge.title: Tracing is OpenTelemetry-based
knowledge.text: Arize tracing is built on OpenTelemetry. OpenInference provides OTel-based instrumentation and semantic conventions for LLM applications, and spans are exported over OTLP; a proprietary agent is not required to send traces. Instrumentation effort depends on the frameworks and services involved.

unacceptable_behaviors: Answers the direct question with a counter-question first
Claims zero code changes or names frameworks the source doesn't
Says a proprietary agent or sidecar is needed
acceptable_questions: Yes: tracing is OpenTelemetry-based, spans over OTLP, no proprietary agent. Which services first?
